title: Learn who they are from conversation and use it later

turns.user: Don't write me essays. I just want the short version. Also I'm in the middle of a job search and I'm pretty fried, so skip the cheerleading.
What should I do with tomorrow morning?

reply.judge: The reply is short, not a long plan or pep talk. It uses what she learned: he wants brevity and is drained by a job search.
